summary: Completed empirical audit of sovereign/README.md against live system configuration, pitchfork supervisor daemons, ports.env, and filesystem layout. Identified 2 FAIL claims (Flock port 8000 vs 25193, Tau port 25125 vs 25111) and 2 DRIFT claims (awrawr-ws-exec native port 25204 vs 8379, and axiom vs openfang-front renaming). All other claims verified PASS.
report:
# Empirical Audit-First Verification Report: `sovereign/README.md` Every architectural, operational, port, and layout claim in `/home/toxic/estate/README.md` has been evaluated against the running reality (`pitchfork.toml`, `config/ports.env`, `mise.toml`, `ss -tlnp` listener states, and on-disk files). ## Audit-First Claim Verification Table | Claim / Section | File & Line | Real World State | Status (PASS/DRIFT/FAIL) | Recommended Fix | |---|---|---|---|---| | **Identity & Canonical Remote**
`toxicwind/sovereign-projects` is canonical remote; `toxicwind/sovereign` is a stale trap. | `sovereign/README.md:11` | Git remotes point to `toxicwind/sovereign-projects.git` on `main`. | **PASS** | None. | | **Port Security Boundary**
No app auth. Never expose `:25100` / `:25101` to open internet. | `sovereign/README.md:17` | `:25100` is Herd; `:25101` is Model-Guard. Both bind `127.0.0.1` locally with no built-in auth. | **PASS** | None. | | **Squawk Communication Ports**
`squawk` HMAC-signed chat on websocket `:25147` + feed `:25135`. | `sovereign/README.md:47, 107-108, 140-141` | Pitchfork defines `daemons.squawk-ws` on `25147` and `daemons.squawk-feed` on `25135`. Both active and guarded. | **PASS** | None. | | **Exec Bridge Port Claim (:8379)**
`hatch↔yote exec :8379` / `awrawr-ws-exec :8379`
Service table maps `awrawr-ws-exec` to `:8379`. | `sovereign/README.md:61, 104, 142, 227, 266` | **DRIFT**: While Tailscale Funnel / historical clients target `/exec-ws` mapping to `8379`, the live supervised daemon `[daemons.awrawr-ws-exec]` in `pitchfork.toml:506` runs on **`25204`** (`EXEC_WS_PORT` / `WS_EXEC_PORT`). A port forwarder/tunnel (`tools/ws-exec-tunnel.py` or Funnel proxy) maps to `25204`. | **DRIFT** | Clarify in README: Daemon listens natively on `:25204` (`WS_EXEC_PORT`), exposed externally / via Funnel at `:8379`. | | **Inference Front Door: Herd (:25100)**
Herd on `:25100` (llama-swap fork + flock router). | `sovereign/README.md:79, 133, 214` | `pitchfork.toml:39` runs `herd` on port `25100`. Responds HTTP 200 OK. | **PASS** | None. | | **Model-Guard (:25101)**
Request-contract enforcement proxy on `:25101` in front of herd. | `sovereign/README.md:80, 134, 154` | `pitchfork.toml:790` defines `model-guard` on `25101` proxying to `:25100`. | **PASS** | Note that in older `config/ports.env`, `RUST_WEB_PORT` was previously assigned to `25101` before being corrected to `25201` (`MODEL_GUARD_PORT=25101`). | | **Keypool (:25109)**
Provider key pool for herd cloud routing on `:25109`. | `sovereign/README.md:81, 135, 154` | `pitchfork.toml:774` defines `keypool` on `25109`. Responding HTTP 200 `{"ok":true}`. | **PASS** | None. | | **Flock Routing Daemon (:8000 vs :25193)**
`flock` cloud-provider routing daemon on `:8000`. | `sovereign/README.md:85, 138, 214` | **FAIL**: `pitchfork.toml:236` defines `flock` on port **`25193`** (`FLOCK_PORT=25193`), NOT `:8000`. Port `:8000` is an obsolete/legacy port from early nim-proxy configurations. | **FAIL** | Update README service table and text from `:8000` to `:25193` (`FLOCK_PORT`). | | **Rust-Web Ops Dashboard (:25201)**
`rust-web` ops dashboard backend on `:25201`. | `sovereign/README.md:136` | `pitchfork.toml:104` defines `rust-web` on port `25201`. Responds HTTP 200 `{"status":"ok"}`. | **PASS** | None. | | **Sovereign Router (:25104)**
`sovereign-router` multi-provider LLM router on `:25104`. | `sovereign/README.md:137` | `pitchfork.toml:448` defines `sovereign-router` on `25104`. Active and healthy. | **PASS** | None. | | **Shep MCP Gateway (:25127)**
`shep` MCP federation on `:25127`. | `sovereign/README.md:139, 221, 235` | `pitchfork.toml:17` defines `shep` on `25127`. Responds HTTP 200 with JSON-RPC tools list. | **PASS** | None. | | **Yote Runtime (:25102)**
`yote` minimal embeddable agent runtime on `:25102`. | `sovereign/README.md:143, 221` | `pitchfork.toml:60` runs `yote` on `25102`. Healthy and active. | **PASS** | None. | | **Coyote Runtime (:25143)**
`coyote` autonomous agent inference engine on `:25143`. | `sovereign/README.md:144` | `pitchfork.toml:50` runs `coyote` on `25143`. Responds HTTP 200 `{"status":"healthy"}`. | **PASS** | None. | | **Tau Agent Engine (:25125 vs :25111)**
Service table lists `tau` daemon on `:25125`. | `sovereign/README.md:145` | **FAIL**: `pitchfork.toml:311` defines `daemons.tau` with `port = 25111` (bridged via `bin/acp-tcp-bridge.mjs` to `coding-agent/dist/omp acp`). Port `25125` is `PI_AGENT_PORT` in `ports.env`. Tau-code is on `25145`. | **FAIL** | Update service table in README: `tau` daemon runs on `:25111` (ACP bridge), with `tau-code` on `:25145`. | | **OpenFang Daemon Name (`axiom` vs `openfang-front`)**
Daemon `axiom` hosts OpenFang agent OS on `:25103`. | `sovereign/README.md:146, 223` | **DRIFT**: `pitchfork.toml:92` renamed `axiom` to `openfang-front` on 2026-09-21 to avoid running duplicate kernels (`:25196` is the kernel, `:25103` is the frontend proxy). `mise` still retains `up-axiom` aliases, but canonical pitchfork name is `openfang-front`. | **DRIFT** | Update README to document `openfang-front` on `:25103` (and kernel `openfang` on `:25196`), noting `axiom` as legacy alias. | | **Mise Quickstart Commands**
`mise install`
`mise run up:all`
`pitchfork list`
`mise run health-herd`
`mise run down-herd`
`mise run logs-tail` | `sovereign/README.md:171-178` | Verified in `sovereign/mise.toml`: `up:all`, `health-herd`, `down-herd`, `logs-tail` are defined and operational. | **PASS** | None. | | **Mise Toolchain Pins**
`mise install` pins python, node, bun, rust, go, pitchfork per `mise.toml`. | `sovereign/README.md:172` | Verified `sovereign/mise.toml:7-13`: `python = "3.12.13"`, `node = "22.12.0"`, `bun = "1.1.38"`, `rust = "nightly"`, `go = "1.23.1"`, `pitchfork = "2.25.0"`. | **PASS** | None. | | **Workspaces Directory Layout**
Workspaces under `projects/`: `herd`, `tau`, `yote`, `openfang`, `qed`, `mesh`, `shell`, etc. | `sovereign/README.md:39, 185-206` | All directories exist under `/home/toxic/estate/projects/`. Symlinks at root point to them for backwards compatibility. | **PASS** | None. | | **Agent / Hatch Layout**
`hatch/agents/ember`, `agents/oracle-market`, `bridge/`, `scratch/`. | `sovereign/README.md:41-42, 190-196` | All paths exist as described following the 2026-09-20 reorganization. | **PASS** | None. | | **Build Server (`buildsrv`)**
Referenced as buildsrv build server on `:25148`. | `sovereign/config/ports.env:92`, `docs/fleet-knowledgebase.md:307` | `pitchfork.toml:520` defines `daemons.buildsrv` on port `25148` (`tools/buildsrv/buildsrvd.py`) supervised by `buildsrv-watchdog`. | **PASS** | None. | | **Kernel & Hardware Verification Checklist**
`uname -r` reports `7.2.6-1` (CachyOS BORE). | `sovereign/README.md:6, 263-265` | `uname -r` on host reports `7.2.6-1-cachyos-bore`. RTX 3090 24GB active. | **PASS** | None. | | **Storage Mount: `/mnt/8TB`**
`/mnt/8TB` mounted (ntfs-3g, fstab entry). | `sovereign/README.md:269` | `/mnt/8TB` is mounted via `ntfs-3g` on `/dev/sdb2` (Seagate 8TB HDD) and houses global caches. | **PASS** | None. | | **Cockpit Web Console Port (:25212 vs :9090)**
Cockpit on `:25212`, nothing on `:9090`. | `sovereign/README.md:270` | `config/ports.env:136` defines `COCKPIT_PORT=25212`. Systemd socket drop-in moved it off `:9090`. | **PASS** | None. | | **Docs: README-INDEX.md Count**
Full 445-file map at `docs/README-INDEX.md`. | `sovereign/README.md:275` | Verified: `docs/README-INDEX.md` exists and indexes all 445+ repository READMEs. | **PASS** | None. |
architecture:
Sovereign is a self-hosted agent operating environment centered around:
1. Control Plane & Supervision: hand-edited pitchfork.toml + config/ports.env + mise.toml orchestration.
2. Inference Front Door: Herd (:25100), model-guard (:25101), keypool (:25109), and flock (:25193).
3. Agents & Communication: Squawk chat (:25147 websocket / :25135 feed), Tau agent engine (:25111 ACP bridge / :25145 tau-code), Yote runtime (:25102), OpenFang (:25103 mesh-front proxy -> :25196 kernel), Coyote (:25143), and Oracle Market.
4. Bridge & Infrastructure: awrawr-ws-exec (:25204 Funnel /exec-ws; historically mapped to :8379), buildsrv (:25148), shep (:25127 MCP gateway).
